caption: This shoyu ramen features a rich amber, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions, topped with dark, glossy nori, pinkish chashu pork, and pale yellow, slightly translucent menma. Served in a white ceramic bowl with a glossy rim, it rests on a wooden table with warm brown grain patterns.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, visible grain patterns, and subtle texture variations.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark, glossy, and irregularly shaped with a slightly rough, textured surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is rich amber, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and faint green specks on their irregular, curled surface.
White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, subtly textured rim.
